title: The Pillar Pair Discipline
summary: The school course in raising and wielding pillars of stone in pairs and finishing a fight with the school's pillar fall.

title: Manual of the Paired Stone Guard
summary: The school manual of guarding in pairs with stone so that one guard breaks the blow and the other returns it.

title: The Azure Cairn Treatise
summary: The school treatise on stacking stones into cairns that guard and mark and fall as one crowning weight.

title: Basin and River Foundation Canon
summary: The school canon of filling a stone basin with earth qi and letting it run out as a flood along the river's course.

title: The Dual-Track Mountain Crown
summary: The school's high course of two tracks of mountain qi that meet at the crown in a single world-shaking fall.

title: The Gale Oath Discipline
summary: The school discipline of swearing stone to the wind and holding that oath through every gust and every blow.

title: Plateau Foundation Reckoning
summary: The school reckoning of broad level foundations that bear the user and break whatever is thrown against them.

title: Reckoning of the Steady Line
summary: The school reckoning of drawing a steady line through stone and striking along it so no blow strays.

title: The Gale-Sworn Mountain Canon
summary: The school canon of mountains sworn to the wind that stand against the gale and answer it with a tempest of stone.

title: The Oath Beneath the Plateau
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn to the bedrock itself and loosed from far below as a rising eruption of stone.
